segments.name: manipulator arms business
segments.description: Sells manipulator arms dedicated to injection molding machines, plus accessories, installation services and new energy products.
segments.evidence: Management has determined that the Company has one operating and reportable segment, which is the manipulator arms business.

revenueModel.text: Customers, mostly in the PRC, pay the company for manipulator arms, accessories, raw materials, installation services and new energy products.
revenueModel.evidence: Accounts receivables are typically unsecured and derived from revenue earned from customers in the PRC, which are exposed to credit risk.
